description: Read the published questions and answers on the current GoVisit blog or documentation page. Use it to find an answer already provided by that page. An optional search narrows the returned entries, which include links back to their source.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

pagePath.description: Canonical GoVisit page path supplying this tool's published context; no origin, query or fragment.

query.description: Optional text to match against published questions and answers.

name: get_page_faq
title: Read published page FAQs
